en: I am Marshal of the Elite Four. I learned all I know from Alder, our former Champion.
My Fighting-type Pokémon and I have trained our bodies and our spirits to the limit. Show me yours!
You return to train with me again? Then I hold nothing back. Come!
Your strength... is the real thing. Your spirit, and your Pokémon's, would make my master proud.
A light began to glow in the corner of the room.
Alder taught me that strength means nothing without care for others. You have both. Go on.
The light carried {player} back down to the hall.
